about:
LAPP Tannehill is headquartered in Savage, Minnesota, where it has operated as a family-owned and operated distributor of wire, cable, tubing, connectors, and related products for 60 years. The company functions as an operating affiliate of LAPP, a global network that develops, manufactures, and distributes eight product lines encompassing more than 40,000 items. While the exact founding year is not disclosed, the business has built a national presence with sales teams across the country and additional distribution centers in Nevada and Texas.

The company’s core offering combines product distribution with a suite of value-added services tailored to customer specifications. These services include wire striping and dyeing for identification, twisting, precision cutting and stripping, re-spooling to custom put-ups, wire and cable marking, tubing cutting and hot-stamp marking, custom labeling, kitting of assemblies, and the Quick Pick inventory management program. LAPP Tannehill also assists with custom cable design from specification through delivery. The operation leverages the LAPP group’s broad catalog, which includes brands such as SKINTOP® cord grips and ÖLFLEX® cables.

LAPP Tannehill serves a diverse industrial base that spans automotive and specialty vehicles, construction, food and beverage, mass transit, material handling, medical, oil and gas, packaging equipment, renewable energy, security, wire harness manufacturing, automation, energy storage and electric vehicles, aerospace, military and defense, building and contracting, lighting manufacturing, and general equipment manufacturing. Its customers range from domestic equipment builders to international contractors seeking reliable wire and cable solutions.

The company attributes its differentiation to four stated values: customer focus, family-based culture, innovation, and success orientation. It emphasizes that cooperation based on trust drives customer success, that its family-owned structure fosters a familiar atmosphere for employees and clients, that it develops forward-looking solutions, and that independence and profitable growth guide its strategy. The Quick Pick program and extensive value-added services are presented as practical expressions of these principles.
